description: Pick a few seconds of a video, choose the size and frame rate, and save a looping GIF. Runs in your browser with no upload.
ogTitle: Video to GIF - A Looping Clip in Seconds
ogDescription: Turn a short part of any video into a GIF with adjustable width, frame rate and speed.
ldDescription: Convert a chosen part of a video into a looping GIF with adjustable size and frame rate in the browser.
lede: Choose a few seconds of a video, set the width and frame rate, and download a looping GIF. Frames are captured and encoded on your device.

faq.q: How long can the GIF be?
faq.a: Up to about 8 seconds. GIF files grow fast, so a 5-second 480 px loop is usually the sweet spot for chat apps and forums.
A GIF stores every frame with a 256-colour palette. Lower the width, frame rate or duration to shrink it - MP4 stays much smaller for long clips.
No. Frames are drawn to a canvas and encoded by a Web Worker in your browser, so the file never leaves your device.
